dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge displays a nearly linear profile with a slight concave curvature near the base ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a small pixel radius and obtuse shape classification.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin, approximately 65 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.4 times the maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius convex curve indicating a smooth, gradual melon slope.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick beak with high vertical-to-horizontal pixel ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle at the transition point between the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-blue coloration across the entire visible surface; presence of low-polygon aliasing on the distal edges of the flippers and flukes.
